about: Only this demo's reviewed objects may be packaged for a system.

osg-demo.description: The hello class and the Airship fleet: its tables, search help, report, audit, BAL, job and job-chain classes, the job reports, OData service, Fiori app, cube and AMDP classes. Transaction ZOSD_FLEET and ZCL_OSD_FLEET_TRAN stay local: the class implements the engine's ZIF_OSD_TRANSACTION, which a system does not have. ZCL_OSD_FLEET_TPL stays local too: it needs ZCL_OSD_TPL and ZCL_AJSON, which are not in this unit.
